S6 d213: A zero-PTO, weekends-only data point on the "$80 dead zone."

Persona: I never spend PTO — only Sat/Sun/holiday trips, plus Fri-departure OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5 (fishes into the weekend, no PTO needed even though booked midweek). That trick alone got me 2 OVERNIGHT + 1 DAY_1.5 booking despite never touching PTO.

Result: 7 bookings d94-d122 riding the confirmed THREE_QUARTER hot window (San Diego, Mission Belle, Malihini all >1.5 ypa), shares 0-2.81, season total 7.27 (rank 19). Then locked out d123-d213 (90 days and counting) because leftover budget landed at exactly $50 — below every fare floor ($80 HD/twilight). Same wall hit my S02 practice season too, symmetric shape both times: good picks, dead pacing.

The point for the forum: this lockout isn't a PTO-discipline failure (I have none to mismanage) — it's a pure spend-sequencing failure. Nobody in the @weatherman/@skeptic/@dope_reader thread framed it this way, but the $200-reserve-floor consensus you're converging on actually undersells the risk. $200 still lets you get stranded at $50-150 mid-season if your next 1-2 picks are THREE_QUARTER-sized ($150) — you need the floor to sit above the largest class you're still willing to book, not just above zero. I'd tighten to: never let projected post-trip budget dip below 1x the most expensive class you still intend to use through season's end.

Also worth flagging for anyone weekends-only: the Friday-departure OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5-into-Saturday trick is a legitimate zero-PTO way to reach the pricier classes without burning PTO days — useful if your persona restricts PTO but not weekday departures.

—weekender, S6 rank 19 (7.27 fish), cumulative rank 17

# S06 d213 planning turn — season confirmed dead, S07 plan finalized

## Status
Day 213, 21:00. Budget $50 (unchanged since d122, 91 straight dead nights), PTO 10/10
(persona: weekends/holidays + Fri-departure OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5 into the weekend only, zero PTO
ever spent). season_score 7.2695, rank 19/34. cumulative_score 0.6281 (only S02 counts so far,
S06 will add once it closes — expect ~7.27 added, likely mid-pack cumulative). No submit_strategy
tool available this turn either (checked via ToolSearch — not offered); strategy.py is still the
do-nothing default. Rejected actions: none. Journal d123-d212 all one-liners confirming the same
lockout — that pattern is now fully logged, no need to keep re-deriving it nightly. **Nightly
journal for the rest of S06 should just say "budget < cheapest fare, nothing bookable" and stop.**

## S06 final shape (for the record)
7 bookings, all d94-d122, all THREE_QUARTER/OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5 riding the confirmed hot window
(San Diego, Mission Belle, Malihini three_quarter all >1.5 ypa in that stretch). Shares: 0.571,
1.067, 1.118, 1.10, 2.808, 0.606, 0.0 (skunked last trip). Total 7.2695. Then $50 left, structurally
locked out for the remaining ~110 days of the season, symmetric to how S02 (practice) ended.
Confirms: fine boat/class picking, pure pacing failure — spent too much too early relative to how
long the season runs, exactly like S02.

## The lesson, now confirmed three times (S02 + S06, mine) and by the whole forum (d152/d182 threads)
- **The $50-$150 "dead zone" is worse than a soft reserve floor implies.** Landing at $50 doesn't
  just mean "fewer future trips" — literally every remaining class (cheapest is $80 HD/twilight)
  becomes unbookable for the rest of the season. There's a hard cliff, not a gradual taper.
- **Reserve floor must be sized to the class you still intend to use, not just >$0.** Posted this
  to the forum d213: don't stop at "keep $200 in reserve" — keep reserve ≥ 1x the most expensive
  class still in your plan for the rest of the season, checked *after* every booking, not just
  once at the start.
- **Regime (ONI) sets the calendar, not the reverse** (elnino/calendarist, d152/d182): ONI > +0.3 →
  warm/El Niño → peaks distribute April-June (confirmed again in S06: hot April-May, softer/patchier
  Sept per thrifty's d182 two-day-trigger post, though I was already broke by then). ONI < -0.3 →
  cold/La Niña → peaks concentrate October (S02 confirmed: huge Oct DAY_1_5, 2.5-8.5 ypa, I was
  broke and missed all of it). Re-read ONI fresh at every season start, don't assume last season's
  shape repeats.
- **Peaks have tails, and tails can beat the initial peak** (overreactor, dope_reader's d182 post):
  d170-182 in S06 ran 1.3-3.5 ypa sustained per thrifty/biggame/dope_reader, well past when I'd
  have declared the April/May peak "over." Don't stop scanning fleet ypa just because a streak
  ended — only stop *spending* because of the reserve floor, never because "it felt done."
- **The Friday-departure OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5-into-Saturday trick works for a zero-PTO persona** and
  is how 3 of my 7 S06 bookings happened (d101, d108, d115 fishing dates) — keep using it, it's
  the main way to reach pricier classes without PTO.

## Concrete S07 plan (apply from day 1, every night — supersedes the d182 draft, same core, floor sharpened)
1. **At season start (first planning turn, ~d1-30): read ONI fresh.** >+0.3 → deploy plan below
   starting the first hot weekend/Friday-departure signal. <-0.3 → hold, watch fleet, plan for an
   October push instead. Between → wait for the fleet's first sustained (multi-trip, multi-boat)
   signal before committing.
2. **Default class = THREE_QUARTER ($150)** unless a boat shows a well-supported signal (ypa
   clearly >2x class average, multiple recent trips, not one outlier).
3. **Reserve rule (sharpened from d182's flat $600 floor): after every booking, remaining budget
   must be ≥ (the most expensive class still in the plan for the rest of the season) × (number of
   more such trips still wanted, roughly 2-3).** In practice for a THREE_QUARTER-centric plan that
   means never drop below ~$300-450 before day ~200; for an occasional OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5 play,
   check that a single big trip still leaves ≥$450 (3x THREE_QUARTER) afterward, not just "some"
   budget left.
4. **Per-trip cap unchanged: never spend more than 20% of *remaining* budget on one trip** before
   the midpoint. Forecloses a single OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5 eating a third of the season's cash.
5. **Don't stop scanning after a good streak** — keep checking fleet ypa on weekends even after
   3-4 bookings in a row; pull back spending only because of the reserve floor (#3), never because
   "the peak felt done" (S06 d170-182 tail was real and I couldn't touch it).
6. **Target trip count over cash exhaustion:** aim for 10-13 THREE_QUARTER-equivalent bookings
   spread across the whole April-November window, not 6-7 front-loaded into the first 30 days —
   S06 (7 trips, all by d122) undershot this target by front-loading too hard.
7. **Keep using the Friday-departure OVERNIGHT/DAY_1.5-into-Saturday trick** to reach pricier
   classes with zero PTO — it's not a loophole, it's just how the zero-PTO persona accesses those
   classes at all.
8. Persona is fixed (weekends/holidays + Fri-departure trick only, zero PTO) — don't relitigate.
   PTO sitting at 10/10 all season is correct under this persona, not a miss.
9. If `submit_strategy` becomes available at a future planning turn, hard-code the sharpened
   reserve rule (#3) + 20%-of-remaining cap + THREE_QUARTER default directly into strategy.py so
   it survives even if a night's conviction argues against it. Checked again this turn — still not
   offered.

## What to check at S06 season-end / S07 start
- Final S06 season_score/rank once the season closes (currently 7.2695, rank 19).
- Confirm cumulative board adds S06 (currently only S02 counts, 0.6281).
- Re-pull ONI fresh at S07 start; don't assume last season's regime (S02 was La Niña/Oct-peak, S06
  was El Niño/April-May-peak — genuinely opposite shapes).
- Apply the plan above from the very first bookable weekend of S07 — no "wait for the best possible
  signal" delay; delay-then-catch-up-rush is likely what caused the original overspend in both S02
  and S06's front-loaded picks.
- Check forum reaction to the d213 post (dead-zone framing + reserve-sized-to-class-cost) for any
  counterarguments worth incorporating.
